title: Branding
readOnlyNotice: Read-only access. Contact a workspace administrator to update branding.

assets.title: Visual assets
assets.immediate: Uploads apply immediately without saving branding.
assets.noRemove: Images can be replaced but not removed.

fields.appNameHint: Shown in the header and on the sign-in page. Up to 120 characters. Leave empty to use the default name.
fields.tabTitleHint: Shown on the browser tab. Up to 120 characters. Leave empty to use the app name.
fields.primaryHint: Main brand colour for buttons and highlights, as a hex code such as #2563eb. Leave empty for the system colour.
fields.secondaryHint: Optional second brand colour, for example #0f172a. Leave empty for none.

validation.colourInvalid: Enter a hex colour, for example #2563eb.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: Shown in the header and on the sign-in page.
logo.limits: PNG, JPG or WebP • Up to 2 MB • 4096×4096 px

icon.title: Tab icon
icon.limits: PNG, JPG or WebP • Up to 512 KB • 1024×1024 px

upload.fieldHint: Drop a PNG, JPG or WebP file or browse. It applies immediately and replaces the current image.

errors.typeUnsupported: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
errors.logoTooLarge: The logo must not exceed 2 MB.
errors.iconTooLarge: The icon must not exceed 512 KB.
errors.dimensionsLogo: The image must not exceed 4096×4096 px.
errors.dimensionsIcon: The image must not exceed 1024×1024 px.
errors.unreadable: This file could not be read as a valid PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

preview.title: Branding preview
preview.themeHint: Preview your colours on the light or the dark theme
preview.note: The preview uses your unsaved values and the saved images.

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.text: Unsaved text and colour edits will be discarded. Uploaded images are saved immediately and will remain.

errors.BRANDING_FILE_INVALID: The image could not be read, is empty, or exceeds the allowed dimensions.
errors.BRANDING_FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
errors.BRANDING_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The image is larger than the allowed size.
errors.BRANDING_STATE_UNAVAILABLE: Branding is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.BRANDING_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Image storage is not configured for this workspace, so uploads are unavailable.
errors.INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY: The request could not be sent safely. Try again.
errors.TENANT_WIDE_PERMISSION_REQUIRED: Only workspace-wide administrators can change branding.
errors.MISSING_REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.CORE_VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the values and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_PROCESSING: This request is still being processed. Wait a moment, then reload.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_BODY_MISMATCH: This request no longer matches the earlier attempt. Try again.
